entries.notes: Comsci publishes self-contained Ubuntu 20.04 and 22.04 deb packages for 100PcVatFreeBridge; no RPM or general distro package was identified.

debian.notes: Vendor lists Ubuntu deb packages; verify Debian compatibility manually before use.

ubuntu.notes: Use the vendor self-contained deb package for Ubuntu 20.04 or Ubuntu 22.04.
